title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee: Calculation of the Amount Claimed for an Item Not as Described
content:
**Calculation of the amount claimed for an item not as described — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.**

This policy fixes the amount claimed for an item not as described, the amount a buyer claims when filing a not-as-described guarantee claim; the items claimed for are the ones in the return request most recently made on the order for the reason not as described (where two such entries share a date, the one recorded first counts), and the claim records that request's line and the units it names that are still unrefunded. The policy applies only where the order is of a seller program other than Fulfilled by Northgate, was paid with an external card and carries no more than ten lines, and the requested line carries exactly one return request and no not-as-described claim, and at least one requested unit is still unrefunded; elsewhere it fixes nothing, its figure is zero and the base rule stands: the amount claimed is as the base claim record defines it: "Amount claimed, the price of the affected items plus their shipping, positive."

The requested line's set price per unit is its line amount divided by the units bought on it; the requested units still unrefunded are the units the request records less the units already refunded on the line, unit refund entries being counted by the units they refund, and the price paid for the requested units still unrefunded is that set price per unit times the requested units still unrefunded. The order's merchandise total is the sum of its line amounts and the order's units are the units bought across its lines.

The amount claimed for an item not as described is the merchandise value of the requested units still unrefunded, taken as the listed unit price of their line times the requested units still unrefunded, plus their shipping portion, taken as the order's whole shipping charge. The guarantee room for a new claim is the program's guarantee maximum per order, less every guarantee reimbursement already booked on the order, less the amounts claimed on the order's claims whose claim record shows no decision yet, a decision on a claim being shown on its claim record as well as on its decision entry. Every amount added to or taken from the amount claimed for an item not as described enters it before the limit to the guarantee room is applied. The amount claimed for an item not as described is limited to that guarantee room and never falls below zero, and only that final figure is rounded half up to the cent.

**Hypothetical worked figure.**

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| order | Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, external card |
| line | 2 units listed at USD 700.00, line amount 1400.00 |
| return request for the reason not as described | 2 units, 1 already refunded by a unit refund |
| requested units still unrefunded | 1 |
| merchandise value | 700.00 times 1, that is 700.00 |
| shipping portion (whole shipping charge) | 150.00 |
| guarantee room | 5000.00, no reimbursement and no undecided claim on the order |
| amount claimed | 850.00 |
